title: Autoresearch loop: one results.jsonl line
description: One experiment in an agent-driven keep/discard loop. results.jsonl is append-only: one JSON object per line, never rewritten; a correction is a new line. Written by log_result.py, which also enforces what JSON Schema cannot (run numbers 1..n with no gaps; revisits_run pointing at an earlier non-kept run).

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the record was written.

kind.description: baseline = the unchanged code; experiment = a new change (or a deliberate revisit); rerun = a repeat measurement of an already-logged commit, to resolve noise.

status.description: pi-autoresearch's four statuses. checks_failed = the dev metric improved but checks.sh failed; treated like a crash (no keep, revert).

commit.description: Short git SHA of the tried change; null only for a crash before commit.

metrics.description: name -> value, parsed from measure.sh's `METRIC name=value` lines (DEV split only; never a held-out score).

hypothesis.description: Why this change should help. Written before the run.

prediction.description: What the metric is expected to do. Written before the run.

description.description: What was changed. For a revisit, what assumption changed since the earlier discard.

rollback_reason.description: Required for discard, crash, checks_failed: the assumption that made the idea fail, so a later result can show it no longer holds.

revisits_run.description: Earlier run number when deliberately retrying a discarded idea because its rollback_reason stopped being true. Not set for verification reruns.
